## 1. CAPA Overview

### Issue Description

Provide a detailed description of the issue or nonconformity that triggered the CAPA process. Include:

- Date and time the issue was identified
- Location/department where the issue occurred
- Products, processes, or systems affected
- How the issue was discovered (e.g., audit, complaint, routine monitoring)
- Initial containment actions taken, if applicable

Example:
> On 2023-06-15, during routine stability testing of Batch XYZ123 of Product A, an out-of-specification (OOS) result was observed for dissolution at the 12-month time point. The OOS result was confirmed through retesting. Initial review of manufacturing records did not identify any obvious deviations during production.

### Issue Category

Classify the issue according to its nature:

| Category | Description | Check |
|----------|-------------|-------|
| Quality | Issues related to product quality attributes, specifications, or quality system elements | □ |
| Safety | Issues with potential impact on patient, user, or employee safety | □ |
| Compliance | Issues involving potential non-compliance with regulations, standards, or procedures | □ |
| Manufacturing | Issues related to production processes, equipment, or materials | □ |
| Laboratory | Issues related to laboratory operations, testing, or results | □ |
| Facilities/Utilities | Issues with facility systems or utilities affecting GxP operations | □ |
| Documentation | Issues related to documentation, records, or data integrity | □ |
| Other | Specify: _________________________ | □ |

### Impact Assessment

Evaluate the actual or potential impact of the issue:

**Severity Assessment:**

| Level | Description | Check |
|-------|-------------|-------|
| Critical | Direct impact on product safety or efficacy; significant regulatory impact | □ |
| Major | Potential impact on product quality; regulatory reporting may be required | □ |
| Moderate | Limited impact on product quality; contained within quality system | □ |
| Minor | No impact on product quality; process or procedural issue only | □ |

**Scope Assessment:**

- Products affected: [List all potentially affected products]
- Batches/lots affected: [List all potentially affected batches]
- Markets/regions affected: [List all potentially affected markets]
- Time period affected: [Specify the timeframe of the issue]

**Risk to patients/users:** [Describe any patient or user risk and mitigating factors]

**Regulatory impact:** [Describe any regulatory reporting requirements or potential compliance issues]

### Root Cause Analysis

Document the methodology and findings of the root cause investigation:

**Investigation Team:**

| Name | Role/Department | Expertise |
|------|-----------------|-----------|
|      |                 |           |
|      |                 |           |
|      |                 |           |

**Investigation Methods Used:**

- □ 5 Whys
- □ Fishbone (Ishikawa) Diagram
- □ Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
- □ Fault Tree Analysis
- □ Process Mapping
- □ Statistical Analysis
- □ Other: _________________________

**Data and Evidence Reviewed:**

- [List all documents, records, data, and evidence examined during the investigation]

**Root Cause(s) Identified:**

Primary root cause:
> [Clearly state the primary root cause identified]

Contributing factors:
> [List any contributing factors that influenced the occurrence of the issue]

**Root Cause Verification:**

> [Describe how the team verified that the identified root cause(s) explain the issue]

## When to Use

Use throughout the project lifecycle to identify, assess, and track risks. This template is essential for projects with significant complexity, multiple stakeholders, or high business impact, where structured risk management provides decision-making value.

## When NOT to Use

Do not use for very low-risk, short-duration tasks where informal risk awareness is sufficient. Avoid this template if your governance framework requires a different risk management approach or if stakeholders prefer real-time risk dashboards over static registers.

8. PIC/S GMP Guide PE 009-14
